description: Return remaining capacity; do not return occupied capacity.

methods.name: Remaining
methods.header:
method Remaining(used: int, cap: int) returns (r: int)
  requires 0 <= used <= cap
  ensures r == cap - used

mutants.violation: Returns used instead of remaining: used=3 cap=10 should produce 7, not 3.

provenance: Locally authored quota-domain diagnostic. Not a public/industrial PSM, independent external source, or held-out benchmark.
